messages:
jen: quick check — my onboard CI for mosaic-x failed the schema lint. errors are: missing 'max_context' and tokenizer special tokens look off (BOS expected id 0 but tokenizer reports 1). weights uri in config is gs://models/mosaic-x/weights/, runtime seems to expect s3. pasting config snippet below, any quick fixes?

jen: ```
{
  \"model_name\": \"mosaic-x\",
  \"weights_uri\": \"gs://models/mosaic-x/weights/\",
  \"config_version\": 2,
  \"tokenizer\": { \"bos_token_id\": 1, \"eos_token_id\": 2 },
  \"sequence_defaults\": { \"pad": 0 }
}
```

tom: I hit this before — schema v2 -> v3 renamed a couple fields. max_context was renamed to context_length in our validator so the linter flags it as missing. we added backward aliases in the validator but not every repo picked it up. try adding context_length (with same value) and re-run the linter: `tools/config_lint.py --path path/to/config.json`

chen: re: tokenizer ids — sometimes the tokenizer files in the model bundle use a different special token mapping (hf -> runtime mismatch). run `python -m tools.tokenizer_inspect --bundle gs://models/mosaic-x/tokenizer/` to confirm the vocabs + special token map. if it does report BOS=1 then we should map it in config to runtime_bos_id or add an alias conversion in onboarding hook.

jen: ok i'm going to add context_length and a runtime_bos_id field and flip the weights_uri to s3 to unblock CI. what's the canonical s3 path pattern?

luis: canonical is s3://redwood-models/<team>/<model>/<version>/weights/ — for onboarding we accept gs:// but serving infra only uses s3. we have a small helper to copy+rewrite URIs: `tools/gs_to_s3.py gs://... s3://...` run it in the onboarding job. i'll file a tiny PR to add a validator alias for max_context -> context_length later today. :+1:

ci-bot: linter-report: FAIL (config/schema) — errors: 1) missing field 'context_length' (hint: 'max_context' found, no alias applied), 2) tokenizer.bos_token_id != runtime expected 0 (found 1). CI job: #onboard-mosaic-x (logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/321/log).

jen: thanks all — i'll push a fix (context_length + runtime_bos_id + s3 path) and re-run. pinging @luis for the validator alias PR if you can.

luis: will do, and i'll add a short note in the onboarding checklist about running tokenizer_inspect before uploading.
